tally.headline: 0 of 3 gradeable claims held up, 3 did not

implied_side.why: EdgeDesk’s own number sat 3 points toward Coastal Carolina of the quote EdgeDesk captured at captured · Pinnacle. That is what the disagreement implied. It was published as research, not as a recommendation to bet it.

implied_total.why: EdgeDesk’s fair total of 55.5 sat 4 points above the captured total of 51.5.

closing_line.why: no closing line is held for this game: the Collective captured none and the schedule feed carries none. Closing-line value is left blank rather than estimated from the result.

reasons: 1 of 1 gradeable claims went the other way. The read of this matchup was wrong in its mechanism, not only in its number.
EdgeDesk projected a home margin of 0.5 and the game finished 17 the away way — 17.5 points of margin error, inside the range the model published.
process.basis: the drivers, matchups and measured advantages only — never the price or the market claim, which are the result in longer words

verdict.line: The number did not land and the reasoning did not either. This is the case that should change something, and the lessons below say what.

grading.separation_note: The bet result and the process grade above are computed separately and are allowed to disagree. A winning number with a broken thesis is recorded as exactly that.

lessons.pregame_expectation: 2 published claims said the same thing: EdgeDesk makes it Coastal Carolina -0.5 where the market has Coastal Carolina +2.5 at captured · Pinnacle — a 3.0 points disagreement. EdgeDesk prices this game at Coastal Carolina -0.5 with a fair total of 55.5, which makes Coastal Carolina the better team here by that margin on this field.
lessons.actual_result: Coastal Carolina Chanticleers lost by 17. Coastal Carolina Chanticleers lost by 17 where EdgeDesk projected a 0.5-point edge.
lessons.lesson: EdgeDesk named Coastal Carolina as better in market and the game went the other way, across 2 separate published claims. One game does not overturn a season-long rating, but this is the direction to watch: the result landed on the market’s side of the disagreement
lessons.suggested_investigation: These claims carried 3.5 points of the published number between them and were contradicted. Check whether the same category has been contradicted in other games this season before touching anything.

lessons.pregame_expectation: 9 of the claims in this article rested on model, passing, rushing, continuity.
lessons.actual_result: None of them could be graded: no single-game statistic in EdgeDesk’s vocabulary observes this driver; the read does not name a side, so there is no direction to test.
lessons.lesson: EdgeDesk prices these games partly on signals it has no way to observe afterwards. That is not an error in the model — it is a gap in the audit, and it means the platform cannot tell, from results alone, whether those parts of the number are earning their weight.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Consider whether a postgame data source exists for model, passing, rushing.

lessons.actual_result: Coastal Carolina Chanticleers lost by 17. the result landed on the market’s side of the disagreement
lessons.lesson: The market had the better estimate here. EdgeDesk’s disagreement was not information on this game, and the honest reading is that the price already contained what the model thought it had found.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Track disagreements of this size across the season. The question is not whether one landed; it is whether the class of them has any edge at all.
